standard_prerequisites.name: The limit-dimension criterion identifies an object of the derived category with its derived limit of canonical truncations when the cohomology sheaves have vanishing higher cohomology on the affine cover

core_obligations: Set H^i = H^i(E) and B the affine opens of X; on all U in B the groups H^p(U, H^i) vanish for p > 0 by the cohomology affine vanishing lemma (proof lines 364-369).

Conclude by the cohomology limit-dimension lemma that the canonical map E -> Rlim tau_{>= -n} E is an isomorphism; the footnote observes that E then has a K-injective representative by the derived categories lemma (proof lines 370-371).
